## About public work

Source: https://godlock.uk/AzielEliab (GodLock product surface. Identity is Aziel Eliab.)
Lead: I made this because a debate with no record becomes a pulpit, and a pulpit with no score becomes a private religion. Intelligent design was never the point by itself. The point was whether a claim could stand in the open, be answered, and leave something behind that was not just my voice.
A claim must stand in the open, be answered, and leave a receipt.
Document over declare.
A claim that cannot be scored is a sermon.
Specified Fit, Not Pretty Spirals.

## Runtime (2.0.0-rc1)

Aziel Runtime is a node-meshed orchestration suite of MCP-connected software designed to route catalog Softwares through the FragGate door, mint receipts, and coordinate mesh presence. Use it to list, describe, and call product operations over MCP or OpenAPI, then keep the returned receipt. It exists so each Softwares product stays a separate engine behind one door.

Live version: 2.0.0-rc1 (certification-point freeze). SoT LIVE: main 70cc0b0 / 2.0.0-rc1. Changelog stays below this abstract.
SoT mesh outlet godlock-uk (SOT-SYNC-1.0): GET https://godlock.uk/v1/sot. Pull POST /v1/sot/sync. Push POST /v1/sot/push. dry_run previews. confirm applies a receipt. Unreachable keeps last-known. Cite strings only (short sha, full sha, suite version, published version_id). Not a Softwares mirror. Published tip version_id be1d6dca-01a9-4d7e-95da-3fffb617a989 (CF_VERSION_METADATA.id, serve-time, read 2026-09-27). version_id 105fa1ee is not claimed. Hub Softwares is hub-scope, not the suite's 42 cards.
Try on Glama: https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/AzielEliab/aziel-runtime (verified listing AzielEliab/aziel-runtime; not an invented server id)
Official Runtime (same-origin): https://godlock.uk/runtime
Official Runtime Worker (secondary): https://aziel-runtime.vibelock.workers.dev/
Source on GitHub: https://github.com/AzielEliab/aziel-runtime
Documentation/Architecture: https://github.com/AzielEliab/aziel-runtime/tree/main/docs/2.0
Kernel: https://github.com/AzielEliab/fraggate (FG-0.1)
One door — discover, route, refuse. FragGate list → describe → call.

## RE-EXPAND-FROM-ARCHIVE

Bytes survive as archive bytes.
Re-expand = archive verify then local node.
